display_name: LoRa W24 逐包局部复谱协方差细化（Full）
description: Match two zero-initialized restoration refiners conditioned on received diagonal versus regularized cross-chirp spectral covariance.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Both arms use L_s true CE, same-source synthetic pairs and fixed E104 clean U_s pseudo CE at confidence >= .95. The observation state only uses received IQ and known chirp alignment. Fit reads no hidden U_s TX, V, registered practical, exact simulation components or target.

checkpoint.initialization: Same legally frozen 40000-update strong-source G; fixed original E104 and G in both arms. New 309572-parameter refiner with identical initialization and zero final edit heads; reset AdamW.

sources.role: New G common source freeze and archival Full comparator.
Frozen first recovery and formal Full historical comparator.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Parent designated by pre-target source gate; target results never determine model, recipe or thresholds.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at +9000. On the same 300 Full source V packets, only cross_chirp_covariance may promote. Require six strictly higher than all comparisons; low urban strictly higher than the diagonal match and at least all archived controls; clean at least direct and the strong-source parent.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 preferred 7,6,0,3,2,5. At least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight existing contexts. At most two train workers and three formal prediction workers, one new worker per physical GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on failed initial identity, invalid parent or source roles, inactive supervised CE gradient, change to frozen E104 or G, nonfinite objective or incomplete prediction. A missed source gate ends the experiment at source.

notes: The auxiliary observation is estimated packet-by-packet after public chirp alignment. For each of two signed ranges [-64,-8) and [8,64), form disjoint eight-bin blocks and exclude the bin being filtered. Estimate each chirp noise from |k| >= 128. Both arms estimate diagonal power with a noise floor. The candidate additionally uses complex off-diagonal cross-chirp covariance, with bounded row norm in the normalized first-order inverse. The auxiliary view goes to the second network alongside unfiltered IQ. No direct substitution of the covariance estimate.

Both arms inherit the same frozen strong-source G, apply the same learned residual scale, and preserve the W24 native edges. Each has identical refiner parameter count and exact initial output. The frozen E104 supplies L_s class gradients and clean U_s pseudo labels at confidence >= 0.95. Both keep the original waveform/clean losses and identical one-third strong white augmentation from -8 to +4 dB; all other draws follow generic source perturbation.

Report source paired distributions, other source metrics and costs for both frozen controls. Only the source-qualified cross-chirp variant can enter official Full prediction with pre-existing source-selected strong-source comparison.
